text:
tian-engsec: quick heads-up, scanner flagged a cluster of libssl CVEs in our ubuntu-minimal base (openssl 3.0.x family, see CVE-2026-XXXX). need to scope which runtime images are impacted and plan a rebuild sweep.

alex-infra: thanks. can someone paste a short inventory of images that pull FROM ubuntu-minimal vs distroless? want to understand blast radius.

maria-dev: quick grep from registry metadata: inference-runtime, model-server, batch-worker, build-tools -> ubuntu-minimal. distroless used for sidecar-agent, small CLI containers. note: one downstream image kept old libssl because CI layer cache preserved /usr/lib, caused segfaults in integration tests after a previous base rebase.

sam-sre: that layer-cache issue is important. rebuild strategy should include explicit cache-bust for layers that install system libs or we must force full multi-stage rebase.

alex-infra: on signing/attestation: current flow uses a long-lived KMS key in project-kms. we should tighten RBAC to limit SignBlob/signPermission to image-signer SA + CI runner pool, and rotate keys post-sweep. any objections?

maria-dev: agree. ephemeral signing keys reduce blast radius but add CI complexity (fetching creds, short TTLs). single long-lived key is simpler but amplifies risk.

sam-sre: my recommendation: create a short-lived HSM-backed key for the rebuild sweep. create, use to sign canaries, then disable and rotate. enforce in promotion: only images signed by an active key-id are allowed to go to prod.

alex-infra: ok. also require structured audit logs on every sign: signer SA, commit sha, SBOM hash, package manifest, and build trigger id. can image-signer be updated? current logs are pretty freeform.

tian-engsec: i'll own sign-service changes. will add structured fields and verify key-id presence during promotion. also want SBOM hash baked into signature payload and recorded in audit.

maria-dev: CI cache-bust snippet i'll add to rebuild job:

```
# Dockerfile tip
RUN rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* && apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends openssl ca-certificates && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
# CI job param to force rebuild
--build-arg CACHEBUST=$(date +%s)
```

sam-sre: proposed sweep plan:
- alex: create ephemeral KMS key and lock down IAM on it
- tian: update image-signer to emit structured audit events and accept key-id param
- maria: run a repo audit for images that do layer-copying and schedule rebuilds with cache-bust to canary repo
- run canary regression matrix (startup, TLS handshake, simple inference workload); hold canaries for 24h
- if green, rotate prod signer and promote images

alex-infra: timeline suggestion: prep today EOD, create key + IAM PR, canary pushes Wed, hold until Fri, promote next Mon. blockers?

tian-engsec: blocker: need list of images that rsync or copy /usr/* from build stage; those likely won't pick up patched libraries unless we rebase. maria can you produce that list by EOD?

maria-dev: on it. already found 2 images using rsync /usr from build stage. will mark for full rebase. also adding SBOM generation into rebuild job.

sam-sre: operational safety: add alert rule: if >1% canary containers restart within 1h of new image rollout, auto-block promotion and notify #eng-security and #eng-sre. i'll add a temporary dashboard with canary pod restarts and TLS error rates.

deploy-bot: vuln-alert: CVE-2026-XXXX applied to ubuntu-minimal:2026-03-18 — image scanned, severity: high.

tian-engsec: assigning action owners: alex (KMS key + RBAC PR), tian (signer upgrade + audit schema), maria (CI cache audit + rebuild list + SBOM), sam (canary policy + alerts). i'll draft a short runbook (steps + rollback triggers) and post to #incidents when we start the sweep.

alex-infra: opened IAM PR: https://git.internal.redwood/infra/iam/pull/482 — draft least-privilege RBAC for signing key, cc: sec-review. creating key now.

maria-dev: ping when key exists, CI needs key-id to sign canary artifacts.

sam-sre: reviewing PR. adding alert and dashboard. will ensure automatic rollback policy triggers on TLS errors and pod restarts.

tian-engsec: final notes: include apt mirror URL and exact package hashes in SBOM so we can reproduce build bits for audit. add a tiny regression matrix: container start, TLS handshake to 1.1/1.2/1.3 servers, simple /infer request with sample model.

maria-dev: acknowledged, adding SBOM step and regression tests to rebuild job. will share the list of flagged images when ready.

alex-infra: updated: key created, IAM tightened. linking key-id in PR.

tian-engsec: thanks everyone. runbook link incoming. we'll coordinate canary schedule in calendar and post status updates.
